{{Quest infobox | name = Family Ties | map = [[Image:Family Ties (Nightfall quest).jpg]] | campaign = Nightfall | region = Kourna | type = Secondary | required hero = Koss | given by = [[Zudash Dejarin]] | given at = [[Yohlon Haven]] | part of = [[The Dejarin Estate]] | preceded by = [[The Young Lady Vanishes]]
[[Tendering an Offer]] }} Reunite the members of the Dejarin family. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== *Required Hero: [[Koss]] ===Objectives=== *Talk to [[Ailonseh Dejarin]] about Koss and the family estate. *Deliver [[Letter from Ailonseh|Ailonseh's letter]] to Zudash Dejarin. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *200 [[Gold]] *100 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s *[[Kournan Coin]] ==Walkthrough== Exit into [[Arkjok Ward]] from [[Yohlon Haven]]. Ailonseh is just a little way to the East of the portal, she will give you a letter when she sees Koss. Talk to Zudash Dejarin in Yohlon Haven for your reward. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 Ailonseh Dejarin ===Enemies=== [[Beast]]s *{{p}} 22 [[Tusked Howler]] *{{p}} 22 [[Tusked Hunter]] [[Insect]]s *{{w}} 16 [[Bladed Veldt Termite]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Veldt Beetle Queen]] *{{p}} 20 [[Veldt Beetle Lance]] ==Dialogues== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Zudash Dejarin''' :''"Koss was a headstrong, impetuous child, and as he grew to manhood we quarreled continually. His poor sister, Ailonseh, always ended up in the middle. When he became a [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]] it was too much for me and I disowned him. He has not used the family name since.'' :''But now that he's given me back part of the family estates, I see that his heart is in the right place even if he has poor taste in friends...present company excluded.'' :''Find '''Ailonseh''' in '''Arkjok Ward'''. Tell her what has happened. Ask her to return to me and help rebuild the family estate. Perhaps we can begin anew."'' {{offer dialog |accept = Family comes first, always. I'll help reunite the Dejarins. |decline = They can work it out on their own. They're grownups. |ask = Find Ailonseh in '''Arkjok Ward''' and tell her about Koss being forgiven. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== '''Ailonseh Dejarin''' :''"Ahai, dear brother. I am so glad that father has finally forgiven you. Of course I will return to help rebuild the estate. It's small, but it's ours. Here, take this letter to father. I will be along presently. And please, brother, come by and visit. Bring your friends...your new friends."'' ===Reward dialogue=== '''Zudash Dejarin''' :''"Forgive my tears, but this day is joyous. You have shown me that my son is a good man. Because of his efforts, our family will again be whole. Please excuse me, I've much work to do. Thank you, again."''
